title: Neta L electric SUV with CATL Shenxing battery starts pre-sale
text:
Neta L electric SUV with CATL Shenxing battery starts pre-sale

# Neta L electric SUV with CATL Shenxing battery starts pre-sale at 19,700 USD

2 min to read May 26, 2024 7:37 PM CEST

Dong Yi Chen

# Understand China EV’s Market

On May 26, Neta opened its Neta L pure electric SUV for pre-sale, available in three trims for consumers to choose from, starting at 140,000 yuan (19,700 USD). The official launch will be in late June and delivery will start in July.

Earlier, four trims of the Neta L EREV version were launched on April 22, with a price range of 129,900 – 159,900 yuan (18,300 – 22,500 USD).

The Neta L is a medium-sized five-seater SUV built based on Neta’s Shanhai 2.0 platform and has dimensions of 4770/1900/1660 mm and a 2810 mm wheelbase. Its standard trunk space is 583 L, which can be expanded to 1,434 L with the rear seats folded down.

In the front, the headlights and triangular opening on both sides form an X-shaped with a closed face and a lower section decorated with dot matrix elements.

The Neta L’s advanced driving assistance functions are powered by two Horizon Robotics Journey 3 smart driving chips, realizing capabilities such as blind spot monitoring, autonomous parking assist, and automatic emergency braking. 

Power comes from a 170 kW (228 hp)/310 Nm electric motor and CATL’s 68 kWh Shenxing battery packs, providing a CLTC range of 510 km. The top speed is 180 km/h and the fastest 0 – 100 km/h acceleration time is 7.6 seconds. Under fast charging, it takes 21 minutes to replenish the battery from 10% to 80%; and charging for 10 minutes can increase the battery life by 180 km.

The interior is provided in two colors: orange and white. There are two 15.6-inch dual screens, integrating the central control screen and the co-pilot entertainment screen, powered by a Qualcomm Snapdragon 8155 chip.

The cockpit also features a built-in refrigerator with a cooling range of -6℃ to 6℃ – which Neta claims is the only refrigerator in its class that can freeze ice cream, and zero-gravity seats with 8-point seat massage, ventilation, and heating.

Other configurations include 16 speakers, headrest audio, small foldable tables for the rear passengers, wireless fast charging for mobile phones, and an AI assistant.
